[[File:Targeting_Assistance_Mem-Stik.jpg|thumb|A Targeting Assistance Mem-Stik]]
A '''Targeting Assistance Mem-Stik''' was a modified memory module rigged to plug into a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to provide combat assistance. When this mem-stik was used, it provided its user with a continuous update on hostile target positions.<ref name="SWG:TAMS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=item|Targeting Assistance Mem-Stik}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Colonel [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] gave a Targeting Assistance Mem-Stik to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] that helped him in his [[Confiscation of Skaak Tipper weapons crates|investigations]] of the criminal [[Skaak Tippers]].<ref name="SWG:TTo">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Tip-off|Naboo}}</ref>
